limits: Only two seeds, ten ordinary generated scenes and four consecutive three-demo/one-query windows were exercised; no full battery.
No parametric extension or canonical repair was attempted.

Generated legends are numerically ascending or descending. The header-direction numeric rival survives these demonstrations but also agrees on their queries; this is a coverage limitation, not a demonstrated ambiguous generated lesson.
Finite tested rivals do not establish universal rule uniqueness.
program:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define priority-colors (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (first g)))
    (define (priority color)
      (let loop ([remaining priority-colors] [idx 0])
        (cond [(empty? remaining) 1000000]
              [(= color (first remaining)) idx]
              [else (loop (rest remaining) (+ idx 1))])))
    (define seeds
      (filter (lambda (cell) (not (= (third cell) 0)))
        (for*/list ([r (in-range 1 (rows g))]
                    [c (in-range (cols g))])
          (list (- r 1) c (at g r c)))))
    (define (covers? seed r c)
      (<= (+ (abs (- r (first seed))) (abs (- c (second seed)))) 1))
    (define (best-seed r c)
      (let loop ([remaining seeds] [best #f] [best-priority 1000001])
        (if (empty? remaining)
            best
            (let* ((seed (first remaining))
                   (rank (priority (third seed))))
              (if (and (covers? seed r c) (< rank best-priority))
                  (loop (rest remaining) seed rank)
                  (loop (rest remaining) best best-priority))))))
    (grid-from-fn (- (rows g) 1) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((hit (best-seed r c)))
          (if hit (third hit) 0))))))
